svg.title: iValtrix — apple code mark
svg.desc: An apple with rainbow code filling its left half and leaf, a white right half, and three fine red, green and purple diagonal stripes. The right half and right side of the leaf stay solid white. Stripe centerline: The silhouette preserves the proportions of Apple’s website navigation mark. Code flows from left to right at varied speeds.
